findings.description: Forward the exception arguments to `__exit__` instead of always passing `None`. Exceptions raised inside `async with attempt:` currently bypass retry handling.
findings.rationale: When an operation raises inside `async with attempt:`, `__aexit__` discards the exception information and calls the synchronous exit handler as though the attempt succeeded. That handler records a successful `None` result and does not suppress the exception, so the exception escapes the retry loop immediately instead of triggering the configured retries.
